1.1.0: FileId inputs changed from 'text' to 'filepicker'. Requires Appmixer 4.4.4 or higher.
1.2.2: Fixed encoding issue with UTF-8 files without BOM.
1.3.2: improve CSV2HTML, CSV2JSON and JSON2CSV, JSON2HTML converters to use streams.
JSON2HTML, CSV2HTML: added support for custom HTML renderers.
1.4.0: PDF2Text: new component to extract text from a PDF file.
1.4.1: Added check for valid XLSX file in XLSX2CSV component. Throwing early if the file is not a valid XLSX.
1.4.2: Output examples for all converters. PDF2Text's file name option reads filename, the key the saved file carries.
1.4.3: Security: upgraded xlsx (SheetJS) to 0.20.3, vendored as the official SheetJS tarball (prototype pollution and ReDoS when reading crafted files; npm has no fixed release).
1.4.4: Security: upgraded tar to 7.5.22 (path traversal, symlink poisoning and hardlink advisories), and moved archiver's transitive minimatch (3.1.5, 5.1.9) and brace-expansion (1.1.21, 2.1.7) to patched versions (ReDoS).
2.0.0: BREAKING: CSV2XLSX, JSON2XLSX, HTML2XLSX, HTML2CSV, HTML2JSON, XLSX2CSV, XLSX2JSON and XLSX2HTML no longer use SheetJS (xlsx); they use read-excel-file and write-excel-file for XLSX, node-html-parser for HTML tables and csv-stringify for CSV output. SheetJS has no fixed release on npm and the vendored tarball never installed (the component uploader stores files as text). CSV2HTML, CSV2JSON, JSON2CSV and JSON2HTML are unchanged.

BREAKING output differences of those eight components: date cells read from a workbook are written as ISO 8601 strings (XLSX2JSON, XLSX2CSV, XLSX2HTML) instead of Excel serial numbers; XLSX2HTML tables keep the same structure (every cell is a <td>, first row is the header, text is escaped) but carry no data-t/data-v/id attributes; a JSON file that is not an array, an HTML file without a table and an invalid workbook fail with a clear error instead of a library crash; input files are limited to 50 MB (CONVERTERS_MAX_FILE_SIZE in the module config). Unchanged: UTF-8 BOM at the start of CSV output, numeric and boolean text becomes numbers and booleans, only the first sheet is read, blank header cells become __EMPTY, __EMPTY_1…, repeated header titles get a suffix (name, name_1, name_2), cells to the right of the header become __EMPTY… columns.

Security: moved minimatch to 11.0.1 (DoS via globparts amplification, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249). Upgraded archiver to 7.0.1 and unzipper to 0.12.5 so that no dependency still needs glob 7 (incompatible with minimatch 11); archiver-utils glob pinned to 14.0.2.
Every converter validates its required inputs (File ID, Data URI, Output Format, File Name) and fails with a clear error when one is missing.
E2E test flows for all 15 converters and a unit test of the XLSX, HTML and CSV round trips.
2.0.1: Security: upgraded csv-parse to 7.0.3 (GHSA-8cw4-87c7-c6xx, prototype replacement via the columns option). CSV2JSON, CSV2HTML and CSV2XLSX now also trim non-breaking spaces and other Unicode whitespace around cell values, as csv-parse 7 aligns the trim option with ECMAScript whitespace.
